FX-CHTHRESH-001.says: As added: Threshold 128, Luminance, Invert off, Blend 0: exactly Threshold at 128 (FX-THRESH-001), grey 128 and everything lighter white, the rest black, each soft edge at its own covering.

FX-CHTHRESH-002.says: Threshold 50: exactly Threshold at 50 (FX-THRESH-005), red white and blue black.

FX-CHTHRESH-003.says: Invert on: FX-CHTHRESH-001 turned over, what was white black and what was black white.

FX-CHTHRESH-004.says: RGB at 128: each channel on its own, so red stays pure red, green pure green, blue pure blue, both skins white and grey 127 black.

FX-CHTHRESH-005.says: RGB at 200: the lit skin, red and green above 200 and blue below, turns yellow; the shadow skin keeps only its red; the light grey turns black.

FX-CHTHRESH-006.says: Saturation at 128: the pure colours and both skins white; the greys, black, white and the dull line black.

FX-CHTHRESH-007.says: Saturation at 150: the shadow skin, saturation 136, turns black while the lit skin, 193, stays white.

FX-CHTHRESH-008.says: Alpha at 129: the two soft edges, covering 128, turn clear; every opaque pixel keeps its colour and covering.

FX-CHTHRESH-009.says: Alpha at 100: the soft edges turn opaque in their own colours; the empty pixels stay empty.

FX-CHTHRESH-010.says: Alpha at 129, Invert on: the soft edges turn opaque and every opaque pixel clear.

FX-CHTHRESH-011.says: Blend With Original 50: every pixel halfway, in linear light, between the drawing and FX-CHTHRESH-001.

FX-CHTHRESH-012.says: Blend With Original 100: the drawing exactly as it was.

FX-CHTHRESH-013.says: RGB, Invert on, Blend 25: each channel turned over, 75 per cent of the way from the drawing.

FX-CHTHRESH-014.says: Alpha at 129, Blend 50: the soft edges at half their covering, the rest as it was.

FX-CHTHRESH-015.says: Threshold keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 255 at frame 4, linear: frame 2 is Threshold 127.5, grey 128 white and grey 127 black.

FX-CHTHRESH-016.says: Blend eased from 50 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it would pass 100, is held at 100, and the frame is the drawing.

FX-CHTHRESH-017.says: FX-CHTHRESH-004 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-CHTHRESH-018.says: Threshold 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHTHRESH-019.says: Threshold -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHTHRESH-020.says: A channel written "red", not one of the four. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHTHRESH-021.says: Invert written "yes", not "on" or "off". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHTHRESH-022.says: Blend With Original 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHTHRESH-023.says: Blend With Original keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
